A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VDLM research and contain 30 pages, including Appendices A-G. Text, equations, figures, and tables can be matched without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original nine-task evaluation results in Table 1, probing and fine-tuning experiments in Appendix A, and perception and error analyses in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 reports original VDLM evaluation results in Table 1, probing and fine-tuning results in Appendix A, and perception and error analyses. Retention from v1 does not alter their empirical status.

M1.justification: Sections 2.1-2.3 retain the same raster-to-SVG conversion, incremental path decomposition, learned SVG-to-PVD mapping, training objective, and GPT-4 reasoning variants. The added checkpoint link documents the existing model rather than establishing a method change.

E1.justification: PVD 160K, all nine downstream tasks, and the Appendix A probing tasks remain unchanged. Section 3 corrects the seventh task's erroneous NLVR label to Geoclidean 2-shot Learning; its Geoclidean data and task requirements were already described in v1.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains LLaVA-v1.5-7B/13B, GPT-4V, and ViperGPT with GPT-4. Appendix A retains the same GPT-4/GPT-4V, LLaVA, Vicuna, and visual-feature probing comparisons.

E3.justification: Training remains three epochs at a learning rate of 1e-5. Evaluation settings, metrics, Table 4 sample counts, and Appendix E prompts are unchanged. The newly specified checkpoint does not establish a revised experimental setting.

E4.justification: The perception-quality analysis in Figure 5, visual-backbone probing in Appendix A, and error categorization and examples in Appendix B are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test, or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Figure 5's regression and KDE analyses and Figure 7's averaging across ten epochs are unchanged. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance reporting is added or removed.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout. For example, Table 1 retains overall accuracy of 0.66/0.67 for VDLM without/with a code interpreter and 0.53 for GPT-4V. Appendix probing results and analysis plots also match.

T1.justification: Equation 1 and the PVD primitive definitions and schemas in Section 2.2 and Appendix C are unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, proof, or mathematical derivation is introduced or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about low-level perception failures, task-agnostic SVG-to-PVD reasoning, zero-shot performance, and interpretability.

C2.justification: Section 4.2, Appendix B, and the conclusion retain the same explanations of perception and reasoning failures, symbolic-input ambiguity, and limitations concerning 3D scenes and natural images.

D1.justification: Section 2.2 adds a footnote identifying and linking the pretrained Mistral-7B-v0.1 checkpoint, whereas v1 names only Mistral-7b. This provides more precise implementation and access information; other reproducibility details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and bibliography are unchanged. The new model-checkpoint link does not introduce a cited research work or revise the paper's positioning.

P1.justification: v3 corrects the Geoclidean task label, adds an acknowledgments paragraph concerning DARPA support, and updates the version stamp and footnote markers. The scientific narrative and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added checkpoint footnote produces local text reflow on pages 5-6, and acknowledgments occupy previously blank space on page 10. Subsequent footnote markers change, while figures and tables retain their content and structure.

improvement.justification: v3 specifies the Mistral checkpoint version left implicit in v1 and corrects Section 3's misleading Geoclidean task label. These provide modest gains in reproducibility and clarity. The method, empirical evidence, claims, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is limited.
